name: physical-ai
description: Podman Desktop extension for Physical AI robotics development

physical-ai.defaultNamespace.description: Default Quay.io namespace for browsing and building images

physical-ai.defaultOpenShiftNamespace.description: Default OpenShift/Kubernetes namespace to use when the current kubeconfig context doesn't specify one (the kubeconfig context's own namespace, when present, always takes priority)

physical-ai.simulationDistro.description: ROS distro for simulation (humble: TurtleBot3 sim; jazzy: sim + noVNC via jazzy-noble preset)

enumDescriptions: ghcr.io/sloretz multi-arch Humble desktop (recommended on Apple Silicon)
docker.io/library/ros:jazzy-ros-base on Ubuntu Noble (multi-arch Quick Start)
docker.io/ros official Jazzy base (amd64 preset, tag :latest)
physical-ai.simulationBaseImage.description: Base image preset for Image Builder builds

enumDescriptions: Show all public repositories in the namespace
Show only repositories matching the curated allowlist
Single-page pipeline: base image (Step 1) and simulation image (Step 2) shown together
Guided chooser: pick whether to build the base image, the simulation image, or both
physical-ai.imageBuilderLayout.description: Layout for the Image Builder page

physical-ai.catalogCuratedAllowlist.description: Comma-separated Quay repository name patterns for Curated catalog view. Use * as a wildcard (e.g. ros2-*-base,ros2-*-sim*,ros2-humble-turtlebot3).

physical-ai.simulationImageAllowlist.description: Optional comma-separated image refs or repo patterns allowed for Simulation launch (e.g. quay.io/ns/ros2-jazzy-sim:noble or quay.io/ns/ros2-jazzy-sim@sha256:…). Empty uses default ros2-*-sim* and ros2-*-turtlebot3. Pin exact tags/digests for demos — local image content is still trusted once selected.

physical-ai.topicPeekTimeoutSeconds.description: Timeout in seconds for Topic Monitor Peek (ros2 topic echo --once). Must be a whole number from 1 to 30.

physical-ai.simulationGpuPassthrough.description: On Apple Silicon (arm64), pass /dev/dri into simulation containers and use virtio-gpu rendering when available. Disable to force software rendering (llvmpipe). Ignored on amd64 (always software GL).

physical-ai.defaultSoftwareRenderCpus.description: Default guaranteed CPU count (requests == limits) for the software-render OpenShift sim pod. Seeds the Software-render CPUs field on the Simulation → OpenShift tab, where it can still be adjusted per deploy. An N-CPU pod only schedules on a node with ≥ N allocatable CPU. Ignored when the cluster-has-a-GPU toggle is on.
